meta.title: 远程摄影指导第6期：荷花池怎么拍
meta.title_en: Remote Photography Coaching #6: How to Shoot a Lotus Pond
meta.topic: 摄影教学 · 机位构图

scenes.context: 学员问荷花怎么拍，老师先问附近有没有高一点的地方。站高才能俯拍整片荷花，避开杂乱的平视角。语域：摄影指导，远程现场教学。
sentences: 你这附近有没有什么高一点的地儿啊？
Is there any higher spot around here?
a higher spot（高一点的地方）
站高一点，上树上行吗？
Stand higher — can you climb up a tree?
climb up（爬上去）
先爬上去，你先站上去。
Climb up first, then just stand on it.
stand on it（站上去）
paraphrase: 找高点 → find higher ground / get some elevation
爬上去 → climb up / get up there
scenes.speak: Is there any higher spot around here? Stand higher — can you climb up a tree? Climb up first, then just stand on it.

scenes.context: 确认学员有85mm长焦后，让他拿起来对着摩拖（远处目标）。站在高处用长焦俯拍，背景就能压成整片荷叶。语域：摄影指导，参数口令。
sentences: 有长焦啊你？长焦有啊，85。
Do you have a telephoto? Yes — an 85mm.
telephoto（长焦）；85mm
拿起来对着摩托。
Pick it up and aim it at the target.
aim it at（对着）
现在整个背景就都是荷叶了。
Now the whole background becomes lotus leaves.
the whole background（整个背景）
paraphrase: 长焦 → telephoto / a long lens
对着 → aim at / point it at
scenes.speak: Do you have a telephoto? Yes — an 85mm. Pick it up and aim it at the target. Now the whole background becomes lotus leaves.

scenes.title_en: Small Aperture to Soften the Background
scenes.context: 老师让学员用一个小点的光圈，强调一定要用小光圈，反正背景拍不清楚，把注意力留给主体。语域：摄影指导，参数设置。
sentences: 让你弄一个小点的光圈。
Set a smaller aperture for me.
a smaller aperture（小一点的光圈）
一定要用小光圈，反正背景拍不清楚。
You must use a small aperture — the background will be out of focus anyway.
out of focus（拍不清楚）；anyway（反正）
没问题，那我小光圈拍了啊，老师。
No problem — I'll shoot with a small aperture, teacher.
shoot with（用…拍）
paraphrase: 小光圈 → a small aperture / a narrow aperture
背景虚化 → out of focus / blurred background
scenes.speak: Set a smaller aperture for me. You must use a small aperture — the background will be out of focus anyway. No problem — I'll shoot with a small aperture, teacher.

scenes.context: 调整机位和参数后，老师喊「OK，来」，画面出来，背景全是荷叶，荷花主体突出。语域：摄影指导，现场收尾。
sentences: 哇塞，有了。
Whoa — we've got it.
we've got it（有了）
现在整个背景就都是荷叶了。
Now the entire background is lotus leaves.
entire background（整个背景）
OK，来。
OK, go.
OK, go（来/拍吧）
paraphrase: 拍出来了 → we've got it / that's the shot
来吧 → OK, go / go ahead
scenes.speak: Whoa — we've got it. Now the entire background is lotus leaves. OK, go.

practice: Is there any higher spot around here?
Do you have a telephoto? Yes — an 85mm.
Set a smaller aperture — the background will be out of focus anyway.
Whoa, we've got it — the whole background is lotus leaves.
pitfalls: Is there any higher spot around here?
「高一点的地方」用 higher spot，不是 tall place。
焦段前用 an：an 85mm；长焦用 telephoto。
「小光圈」用 a smaller / narrow aperture。
The background will be not clear.
The background will be out of focus anyway.
「拍不清楚」用 out of focus，比 not clear 更摄影化。
shifts: 用 we've got it（有了）、that's the shot（就是这张）、whole background（背景全压住）
用 telephoto（长焦）、85mm、aperture（光圈）、higher ground（制高点）
用 out of focus（失焦）、soft background（柔和背景）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：摩托→目标、长焦、85、光圈、荷叶、坡→坡等。
